source.pixel_coordinates: origin top-left; x right, y down; polygons are source-image pixels
source.archive_requirement: Use the SSD project archive of the user image, never depend on its temporary clipboard path at runtime.
source.content: Clean scene artwork only. Player, enemies, damage, projectiles, drops, portal and UI must remain live game objects.

view.camera_policy: Fixed calibrated camera for this painted arena. No free orbit or unbounded follow until geometry/layer registration supports it.
view.angle_semantics: 60 degrees means camera pitch down from horizontal, not horizontal FOV. The two settings must remain explicit.
view.overscan_reason: Reserve painted walkable terrain outside the actual viewport for existing off-screen enemy spawning. Full-artwork-in-view plus closed painted bounds leaves no off-screen spawn space.
view.letterbox_or_crop: Keep art, collision and live actors under one shared image-to-world transform. At other aspect ratios crop consistently or use a common letterboxed play viewport; never stretch only the art.

mapping.method: Perspective source-pixel ray intersecting ground Z=0, using the virtual calibration frustum.
mapping.ground_point: P=C+R*(-C.z/R.z); require R.z<0 and intersection ahead of C
mapping.important: Do not reuse the village orthographic 48-degree ReferencePoint affine mapping. Choose D once and use the same ray mapping for walk/block polygons, spawn, path nodes and layers.
mapping.art_registration: Ground patch must use perspective-correct registered UVs or subdivided geometry. Sky and distant hills are backdrop, never gameplay ground. Cut tree/cart/fence foreground masks into depth layers; keep shadows/footprints registered to the same ground.

character_scale.calibration_distance: For a camera-facing 180cm visible body at the reference focus depth: D=f*180/84. Recompute using the actual nontransparent sprite bounds, not its whole texture canvas.
character_scale.evidence_limit: No human is present in the source image. 84px is an initial art-direction calibration, not a measured human scale in the image.
character_scale.ui_reference_comparison: ReferenceHUD.png has about a 100px visible central body at 1672px viewport width. An 84px source body with 1.2x overscan displays at about 100.8px at that viewport width, before perspective depth changes.
character_scale.perspective_requirement: Keep world character height constant. Farther ground positions appear smaller naturally; do not force constant pixel height while claiming perspective.
character_scale.feet_requirement: Live player/enemy feet and shadow share the mapped ground point. Transparent canvas margins must not change the 180cm visible height or baseline.

walk.name: main_meadow
walk.notes: Conservative mainland footprint. The horizon, distant hill/animal strip and all south-bank foreground are outside gameplay. Erode by the actual actor radius in world cm.

blocked.name: old_oak_trunk_rock_and_upper_left_fence
blocked.notes: Trunk/rock/fence footprint; canopy belongs to a separate occlusion mask and must not become a huge invisible wall.

blocked.name: cart_wheels_body_and_loose_equipment
blocked.notes: Ground contact footprint; split the cart's upper body into an occlusion card so actors behind it are not drawn over its woodwork.

spawn_and_portal_contract.player: Require walkable(spawn, player_radius_cm) and one reachable main component. Never use a random world rectangle without intersecting this geometry.
spawn_and_portal_contract.enemies: Per enemy Definition radius, require valid ground polygon, outside blocked polygons, swept clearance, path to player, and actual projected off-screen status. Treat listed points as candidates only. Refuse safely and retry if no legal off-screen point.
spawn_and_portal_contract.portal: At 300s choose a random legal point in the same reachable component. Require at least 240cm free radius, a path for player radius, and a standable 220cm interaction area. Candidate anchors do not make the portal fixed.
spawn_and_portal_contract.projection: Use ProjectWorldLocationToScreen/deprojection for perspective frustum tests. Old ViewWidth orthographic half-height rectangles are not a valid perspective off-screen test.
spawn_and_portal_contract.boss: Do not silently reuse the existing 32x26m Boss ellipse without checking its intersection with the painted ground and river. Either keep the separate Boss stage or explicitly author a compatible painted Boss stage.

qa_required: Project every authored polygon vertex and spawn back to reference pixels; roundtrip error <=2 source pixels at the calibration camera.
Player/enemy movement and dodge sweep cannot cross river, fence, cart, trunk or world boundary at any supported frame time; no invisible collision over decorative flowers.
Check full playable grid connectivity with actual player radius; each path node must be reachable from spawn.
Check ordinary, elite and configured maximum supported enemy radii; spawn and chase cannot enter distant hills, water or isolated banks.
At least one legal off-screen enemy spawn remains under each target aspect ratio; test actual viewport projection, not source-pixel bounds alone.
At 300s repeatedly sample portal candidates, including player near river/fence/cart; all chosen portals have 240cm clearance and reachable interaction space.
At 1280x720, 1920x1080 and 1024x768 inspect near/center/far character feet, 180cm world size, tree/cart depth sorting, danger markers and live projectiles.

UI must be excluded from scene extraction. Compare HUD layout in normalized play-viewport coordinates and verify it does not cover feet, danger cues, portal interact text or unletterboxed image alignment.
Background artwork contains no baked player, enemies, projectiles, damage numbers or HUD. Live simulation remains interactive and pause/cross-stage rules still pass.

ui_reference_qa.semantics: Compare frame anchors after common DPI scaling. HP, level, cooldown, time, kills, coins, skill state and minimap marks must come from live state; reference numbers and enemies are not screenshot content to bake into the HUD.

limitations: Polygon vertices and 84px body calibration were manually authored from the supplied raster. They require in-engine overlay and swept-radius validation before gameplay acceptance. This spec is not a map, finished collision import or completed runtime QA.
